inspection_method: static GitHub connector source inspection + project conversation context; no runtime execution this turn
limitations: DPT IDs are extraction IDs, not assigned ABBI-M canonical identifiers.
c64_source means source exists in the C64 gameplay path, not hardware certification.
c_module_not_wired indicates C helper exists but is not used by C64 main gameplay loop.
host_prototype indicates isolated Python prototype or fixture; not necessarily carried into C64 gameplay.
design_goal is not implemented and should not be counted as executable.
